scoring_justification: Result-level compare; recompute from raw DFT intermediates is infeasible inside the verifier sandbox. Compare agent's reported interaction energies V_n to paper's PAW-VASP relaxed values with absolute tolerance 0.05 eV.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold V_n values for seven defect pairs at shells 1-3
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 (Al-Al,Cu-Cu,S-S relaxed), Table 3 (vacancy-solute), Figure 1 (Al-Cu off-diagonal)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published values; verified against the reference solve.sh to ensure consistency with the same drawn from the paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's reported PAW-VASP relaxed interactions for the specified pairs under the same conditions (128-atom supercell, FM state, 0.286 nm). No synthetic data.

outputs.description: Effective pair interaction energies (eV) for the specified defect pairs at 1st, 2nd, and 3rd nearest-neighbour coordination shells.

output_contract.notes: The verifier compares the reported interaction energies to the paper's published PAW-VASP relaxed values with a tolerance of 0.05 eV per entry.

steps.description: Compare each V_n (eV) against paper gold; fraction of entries within 0.05 eV.
